grammar: SIGIL = Compose(C, G, S, R, O, N)

laws.composed_not_decorated: every axis cites the tested kernel structure it derives from
laws.no_state_by_color_alone: every sigil carries its mono text label; color is redundant encoding (style_lock)
laws.representation_only: a sigil has (dP,dA,dE)=(0,0,0); no status word without an adjacent receipt ref (beautiful_seal_is_not_admission)
laws.symbolic_not_physical: chakra column adopted as color->function mnemonic only; sacred ratios are composition tools, not metaphysics
laws.signature_gesture: the hem: every sigil is bordered; the hem is the admission boundary made visible
laws.adversarial_complements: complementary color pairs (red-green, orange-blue, ochre-indigo) reserved for adversarial displays, always labeled
laws.static_sigils: no ambient motion; movement only on receipt-witnessed state transitions

gold_line.usage: hem and rules only, never fill

sigils.derivation: one counterexample suffices; one BLOCKED->RECOVERED outweighs fifty documents (tested reward law)
one bounded packet, one human/policy decision
final verdict alphabet PASS|HOLD|REVERT (compare/verify chain, tested)

notes.duplicate_numbers: N=6 appears twice (gym, simulator): uniqueness is not required, derivation is; color+geometry disambiguate — the source panel itself reuses numbers
notes.primitive_library: motifs outside the ATF primitive catalog (natural, maritime, geometric) require operator admission before use
notes.proportions: square grid, 1:sqrt(2) margins, central motif in the phi-inverse orthogon — proportions, not meanings
